_comment: Screen rules for the ONE state Bob's hooks cannot report: blocked.
Bob has no approval/Notification hook event, so a tool-approval prompt is
invisible to the lifecycle bridge and has to be read off the pane.
Rules are matched, in order, against the bottom of the pane buffer.
Keep them strict: an unmatched screen falls back to the hook's state, which
is safe; a false `blocked` stops waits and lights up the sidebar wrongly.
`all` entries must every one match; `any` needs one; `none` must not match.
Patterns are POSIX extended regexes, matched case-insensitively, one line
at a time: two patterns that cannot share a line are a two-line anchor.
Key a dialog on its own heading and its own option, not on a footer that
another dialog may share. No bracket expression may hold a multibyte
character: under LC_ALL=C, BSD grep reads `[>❯→]` byte-wise and the class
matches any box-drawing line. Use alternation, `(>|❯|→)`.
